concurrency.florida_statutory_basis: Chapter 163 Part II F.S. and Rule 9J-5 F.A.C.
concurrency.palm_bay_requirement: Concurrency review through development agreement process (Code Sections 172.090-172.093)
concurrency.level_of_service_standard: Adopted in Comprehensive Plan — most Florida cities use LOS D for arterials/collectors
concurrency.malabar_road_status: SR 514 (2-lane segment) operating at ~16,000 vpd — likely AT or BEYOND LOS D capacity (~11,500-15,400 vpd)
concurrency.concurrency_concern: If Malabar Road is failing adopted LOS, new development must demonstrate capacity, funded improvements, or proportionate fair-share contribution
concurrency.project_impact: De minimis — 36-100 daily trips = 0.2-0.6% of 16,000 vpd corridor volume
concurrency.proportionate_fair_share: F.S. 163.3180(16) allows developer contributions when facilities unavailable
concurrency.moratorium_2022: Palm Bay imposed temporary moratorium on residential FLUM amendments/rezonings in Sept 2022 for Comprehensive Plan update — verify current status
